Two angels reached Sodom at evening, and Lot welcomed them into his house.
That night, the men of the city surrounded the house, demanding Lot's guests.
The angels pulled Lot inside and struck the crowd with blindness.
They said: the Lord has sent us to destroy this city. Take your family and go.
His sons-in-law thought he was joking.
At dawn Lot still hesitated. The angels took their hands and led them out, for the Lord was merciful.
Flee to the hills, they said. Do not look back.
Lot reached the little town of Zoar as the sun rose.
Then the Lord rained sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah.
Lot's wife looked back, and became a pillar of salt.
In the morning, Abraham saw smoke rising over the Plain. God had remembered Abraham, and brought Lot out.
Lot hesitated, yet the angels took him by the hand.
That is mercy: God pulls us out before we have fully let go.
Jesus said: remember Lot's wife. Do not keep looking back at what God has led you out of.
What is God asking you to leave behind?
